§6Dimlet Workbench§f

§aCraft and deconstruct dimlets, the building blocks of custom dimensions.§f

The §bDimlet Workbench§f is your workshop for dimlet engineering. Use it to:
§b• Deconstruct§f: Break down dungeon dimlets into §bMemory Chips§f, §bControl Chips§f, and §bEnergy Cores§f
§b• Craft§f: Combine chips with a base item (Diamond Block, water bucket, etc.) to make custom dimlets
§b• Analyze§f: Open §bDimlet Parcels§f from exploration for random rare templates

§6Dimlet Categories§f:
§bMaterial§f (terrain blocks), §bFluid§f (lakes/oceans), §bBiome§f, §bTime§f (day/night lock), §bWeather§f, §bStructure§f, §bFeature§f

§cOrder matters§f in the Enscriber, modifier dimlets go §eimmediately before§f the feature they affect. A Diamond Material Dimlet before a Flat Terrain Dimlet gives you solid diamond flats.

§9Note:§f Deconstruct every dimlet you find early on. You'll need the components to craft the dimlets you actually want.
